Strings.guardian.login_required: Process Guardian requires sign-in. Connect to a RelaxKonOS Server before starting this app.
Strings.guardian.status.install_required: Guardian Agent is not installed or configured on this host. An administrator must run the RelaxKonOS host installer.
Strings.guardian.definition_load_failed: Could not load the workload definition. The editor was not opened; retry the operation.
Strings.guardian.validation.required: Enter a name, executable path, working directory, and run-as account.
Strings.guardian.create.name: Workload name
Strings.guardian.create.name.help: Used to identify this service in the list, logs, and alerts. You can change it later.
Strings.guardian.create.executable.help: Enter an absolute program or interpreter path, or a bare name available in the Guardian Agent PATH. A name is resolved and saved as an absolute path; do not enter a complete shell command.
Strings.guardian.create.working_directory.help: The directory the process starts in. Relative paths used by the program are resolved from here.
Strings.guardian.create.arguments.help: Enter one separate argument per line. Quotes are not needed; do not use pipes, redirects, or other shell syntax. Leave blank when there are no arguments.
Strings.guardian.create.run_as.help: The host account used by the child process. It defaults to your signed-in account; another account requires host-administrator approval.
Strings.guardian.admin_approval.title: Confirm cross-account launch
Strings.guardian.admin_approval.message: Running a guardian workload as another account requires host-administrator approval. Enter any administrator account and its password; the credential is used for this request only.
Strings.guardian.create.enabled_on_boot.help: When enabled, Guardian Agent starts this workload after the host boots and its service is restored.
Strings.guardian.info: Guardian runs workloads on this host independently of the RelaxKonOS RelaxKonOS.Server. The run-as account and host determine access to program files.
Strings.guardian.editor.intro: Describe how to start the program. Guardian Agent starts and supervises it directly after saving; the working directory must be absolute, while a program name is resolved from its PATH.
Strings.guardian.table.name: Name
